```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                       fig.align = "center", fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4)

if (!exists("project_folder")) {
  project_folder <- getwd()
  pipeline_folder <- getwd()
  features_file <- "config/features.yaml"
  sample_file <- "config/samples.tsv"
}

source(file.path(pipeline_folder, "workflow", "scripts", "R", "report_helpers.R"))
samples <- read.delim(file.path(project_folder, sample_file), comment.char = "#")
features <- yaml::read_yaml(file.path(project_folder, features_file))
host_names <- names(features$hosts)
```

# Adapter/quality trimming (fastp)

```{r fastp-summary}
fastp_dir <- file.path(project_folder, "results", "preprocess", "fastp")
json_files <- file.path(fastp_dir, paste0(samples$sample_id, ".", samples$library_id, "_fastp.json"))

fastp_df <- purrr::map2_dfr(json_files, paste(samples$sample_id, samples$library_id, sep = "."), function(f, lib) {
  row <- parse_fastp_json(f)
  if (nrow(row) == 0) return(NULL)
  dplyr::bind_cols(library = lib, row)
})

if (nrow(fastp_df) == 0) {
  cat("_No fastp output found yet._\n")
} else {
  preview_table(fastp_df, n = nrow(fastp_df), caption = "fastp: reads before/after filtering, Q30 rate, duplication")
}
```

# Host decontamination

Each configured host is mapped against sequentially; the percentage below is
the share of that library's reads still present (i.e. not yet removed as
host) at each step.

```{r host-decontam-summary}
if (length(host_names) == 0) {
  cat("_No hosts configured -- reads pass straight from fastp into read_annotate/assemble._\n")
} else {
  bowtie2_dir <- file.path(project_folder, "results", "preprocess", "bowtie2")

  decontam_df <- purrr::map_dfr(host_names, function(host) {
    purrr::pmap_dfr(samples[, c("sample_id", "library_id")], function(sample_id, library_id) {
      f <- file.path(bowtie2_dir, host, paste0(sample_id, ".", library_id, ".chr_alignment_counts.tsv"))
      if (!file.exists(f)) return(NULL)
      counts <- read.delim(f, header = FALSE, col.names = c("chr", "mapped_reads"))
      tibble::tibble(
        host = host,
        library = paste(sample_id, library_id, sep = "."),
        mapped_reads = sum(counts$mapped_reads, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    })
  })

  if (nrow(decontam_df) == 0) {
    cat("_No host-mapping output found yet._\n")
  } else {
    wide <- tidyr::pivot_wider(decontam_df, names_from = host, values_from = mapped_reads)
    preview_table(wide, n = nrow(wide),
                  caption = "Reads mapped to each host, per library (host order = decontamination order)")
  }
}
```
